walk.zh: 长腿落地,几乎不留声音。
walk.en: My long legs land almost without a sound.

walk.zh: 我走得很快,却不肯显得匆忙。
walk.en: I move fast, yet refuse to look hurried.

walk.zh: 细足点在石上,一步不滑。
walk.en: My thin feet find stone and never slip.

walk.zh: 我绕过泥坑,脏东西别碰我。
walk.en: I step around the mud; filth must not touch me.

walk.zh: 这件白壳,走起来要护好。
walk.en: This white shell needs care when I walk.

walk.zh: 我在草叶上悬了一瞬再落。
walk.en: I hover above a blade of grass, then land.

walk.zh: 六条腿交替,节奏像舞步。
walk.en: Six legs trade places in a dancer's rhythm.

walk.zh: 我侧身走过窄缝,毫不费力。
walk.en: I turn sideways through the gap without effort.

walk.zh: 触角先探路,身体随后跟上。
walk.en: Antennae scout ahead; the body follows.

walk.zh: 我不是这片土地长大的。
walk.en: I did not grow up on this land.

walk.zh: 足壳敲在地面,发出轻响。
walk.en: My shell-tipped feet tap out a light rhythm.

walk.zh: 优雅是走路唯一的要求。
walk.en: Elegance is the only rule of walking.

idle.en: I tidy my antennae in the water's reflection.
The wind has mussed me. How rude.

idle.zh: 我立着不动,像一件摆设。
idle.en: I stand perfectly still, like an ornament.

idle.zh: 这片草地太粗糙,我不坐。
idle.en: This grass is too coarse. I will not sit.

idle.zh: 我数着远处落下的光点。
idle.en: I count the specks of light falling far away.

idle.zh: 壳上有一道划痕,得记住。
idle.en: A scratch on my shell. I must remember it.
I raise a hand, glance at it, lower it.

idle.zh: 别的生物都躲着我,正常。
idle.en: The others avoid me. That is normal.

idle.zh: 在这儿站着,比打架体面。
idle.en: Standing here is more decent than fighting.

idle.zh: 我听见风里有陌生的响声。
idle.en: I hear an unfamiliar sound inside the wind.

idle.zh: 这么安静,反而让我警觉。
idle.en: This quiet makes me more alert, not less.
I shake my legs to shed the grass bits.
Beauty requires daily maintenance.

idle.zh: 我望着来路,回想另一个世界。
idle.en: I look back the way I came, remembering another world.

look_player.zh: 你站得够远,还算懂规矩。
look_player.en: You keep your distance. You know some manners.

look_player.zh: 我打量你,从头到脚。
look_player.en: I look you over, head to foot.

look_player.zh: 你的鞋上全是泥,离我远点。
look_player.en: Your boots are caked in mud. Step back.

look_player.zh: 你身上有铁锈和汗的味道。
look_player.en: You smell of rust and sweat.

look_player.zh: 你握东西的姿势不太好看。
look_player.en: The way you grip that is not pleasing.

look_player.zh: 我偏头,想看懂你的表情。
look_player.en: I tilt my head, trying to read your face.

look_player.zh: 你在害怕,我看得出来。
look_player.en: You are afraid. I can tell.

look_player.zh: 你比我见过的多数生物干净。
look_player.en: You are cleaner than most creatures I have met.

look_player.zh: 别眨眼,我在挑你的毛病。
look_player.en: Do not blink. I am finding your flaws.

look_player.zh: 你的影子投在我脚边,让开。
look_player.en: Your shadow falls on my feet. Move it.

look_player.zh: 我盯着你,直到你先移开眼。
look_player.en: I stare until you look away first.

look_player.zh: 你的呼吸有点乱,我数着呢。
look_player.en: Your breathing is uneven. I am counting it.

look_player.zh: 你这身打扮,勉强说得过去。
look_player.en: That outfit of yours barely passes.

look_player.zh: 我对你有点兴趣,仅此而已。
look_player.en: I take some interest in you. Nothing more.

tempted.en: That sweetness. Is it meant for me?

tempted.zh: 我不吃粗糙的东西,拿开。
tempted.en: I do not eat coarse things. Take it away.

tempted.zh: 花蜜的香气让我挪不动步。
tempted.en: The scent of nectar pins my feet in place.
You hold it out as if teasing a child.
I come one step closer, only to smell it.

tempted.zh: 这么甜,会弄脏我的口器。
tempted.en: So sweet it would soil my mouthparts.
I reach out with an antenna to touch it first.
Keep your hand steady or I may change my mind.

tempted.zh: 我承认,这味道挑得不错。
tempted.en: I admit it. The scent is well chosen.
One taste only. I will not thank you.

collide.en: You touched me. Three steps back.
I stumble once, then straighten at once.
My shell is thin and does not take impacts.

collide.zh: 走路不看方向,是你的错。
collide.en: Walking without looking is your fault.

collide.zh: 我甩了甩腿,把碰撞抖掉。
collide.en: I shake my legs to throw off the bump.

collide.zh: 这么粗鲁,难怪没人靠近你。
collide.en: So rough. No wonder nothing comes near you.

collide.zh: 我扶住草茎,才没有跌倒。
collide.en: I catch a stalk of grass and do not fall.
Do not open a path with your shoulder. Use your eyes.

collide.zh: 碰一下,我的姿态就乱了。
collide.en: One bump and my poise is ruined.

collide.zh: 我绕开你,不想再说第二遍。
collide.en: I go around you. I will not repeat myself.

mate.zh: 这种事,我只和同类商量。
mate.en: Such matters I discuss only with my own kind.

mate.zh: 我摆好姿态,让对方先开口。
mate.en: I arrange my pose and let the other speak first.

mate.zh: 在另一个世界,我们有别的礼数。
mate.en: In the other world we keep different rites.

mate.zh: 我不用叫声,我用动作示意。
mate.en: I do not call out. I signal with movement.

mate.zh: 太近了,礼貌要求你退一步。
mate.en: Too close. Courtesy asks you to step back.

mate.zh: 我的翅膜会轻轻震动作答。
mate.en: My wing membrane shivers in reply.

mate.zh: 这份美要传下去,不能马虎。
mate.en: This beauty must pass on. No carelessness.

mate.zh: 我绕着对方走一圈,再决定。
mate.en: I circle the other once before deciding.

mate.zh: 别出声,安静才显得郑重。
mate.en: Stay silent. Quiet makes it solemn.

mate.zh: 我低头,这已经是答应了。
mate.en: I lower my head. That is already a yes.

pickup.zh: 这东西沾了土,我用触角夹。
pickup.en: This is dusty. I lift it with my antennae.
I will not bend over. Bending is unbecoming.

pickup.zh: 这只手空着,就顺手拿了。
pickup.en: This hand was free, so I took it.

pickup.zh: 我举起来看,再决定要不要。
pickup.en: I hold it up to look before deciding.
Too heavy. My legs are too slender.
Bright things earn a second look from me.

pickup.zh: 放下时轻一点,别弄出响声。
pickup.en: I set it down gently, without a sound.
I dust it off before I will carry it.

pickup.zh: 这不是我的,但我先拿着。
pickup.en: This is not mine, but I will hold it.

pickup.zh: 两件里我挑干净的那件。
pickup.en: Of the two, I take the cleaner one.

target_acquire.zh: 你动得太明显,我看见了。
target_acquire.en: You moved too plainly. I saw you.
A target. First, measure the distance.
I do not rush; rushing makes me miss.

target_acquire.zh: 这一只,值得我认真一次。
target_acquire.en: This one is worth being serious for.
Its weight leans left. Noted.

target_acquire.zh: 我把身体压低,腿收起来。
target_acquire.en: I lower my body and draw my legs in.
The air tightens. It has not noticed.
Chosen. I will look nowhere else.
I wait for it to slip before I move.
Even beauty must strike accurately.

targeting.en: I follow you without missing a step.
Where you turn, my antennae turn.

targeting.zh: 别跑,跑起来就不体面了。
targeting.en: Do not run. Running is undignified.
I count your steps. Three, two, one.

targeting.zh: 你的破绽在右肩,一直都有。
targeting.en: Your gap is at the right shoulder. Always.

targeting.zh: 我贴着草尖滑过去,没声。
targeting.en: I slide along the grass tips, silent.

targeting.zh: 耐心是捕猎里最贵的部分。
targeting.en: Patience is the costliest part of a hunt.
I do not shout; shouting startles prey.

targeting.zh: 再近一点,我就能碰到了。
targeting.en: A little closer and I can reach you.

targeting.zh: 你的呼吸告诉我你累了。
targeting.en: Your breathing tells me you are tired.

melee_attack.zh: 一记直踢,先断你的架势。
melee_attack.en: A straight kick to break your stance.

melee_attack.zh: 我的腿比看上去硬得多。
melee_attack.en: My legs are harder than they look.
I held back three tenths of that blow.
Too fast? I have not warmed up.

melee_attack.zh: 落地前,我已经换好姿势。
melee_attack.en: Before landing, I have already reset my pose.
Fighting is angles, not brute force.
You blocked it. Good. Again.
I strike with a knee, not a claw.
Does it hurt? Then go back.
Clean and quick. That is courtesy.

spawn.zh: 我从另一道缝隙里走出来。
spawn.en: I step out of another seam in the world.
The grass here is shorter than I expected.

spawn.zh: 六十级的重量,压在这片土上。
spawn.en: Level sixty settles onto this soil.
The light is harsh. I narrow my eyes.

spawn.zh: 我又被丢到陌生的地方。
spawn.en: I have been dropped somewhere strange again.

spawn.zh: 先看清四周,再决定去留。
spawn.en: First I read the surroundings, then decide.

spawn.zh: 空气里有铁与水的味道。
spawn.en: The air carries iron and water.

spawn.zh: 这具身体不该出现在这里。
spawn.en: This body does not belong here.

spawn.zh: 落地时,我把声音收住了。
spawn.en: On landing, I keep the sound inside.

spawn.zh: 看看这次的世界长什么样。
spawn.en: Let me see what this world looks like.

spawn.zh: 我从很远的地方来,不认得路。
spawn.en: I come from far away and know no road.

spawn.zh: 既然来了,就先把姿态摆好。
spawn.en: Since I am here, let me set my pose first.

generic.en: You touched my shell.
This pain does not earn a frown.
A layer of my dust has been scraped off.
Back off. I do not want soiled hands.
My legs tremble. Only for a moment.
You have ruined my posture.
I will remember that blow.
I am still standing. Do not celebrate yet.
A hairline crack. No longer beautiful.
Pain makes me clearer.

fire.en: Fire will bake my shell brittle.

fall.zh: 从高处落下,腿差点折了。
fall.en: I fell far and nearly snapped a leg.

drown.zh: 水灌进口器,我浮不起来。
drown.en: Water fills my mouthparts; I cannot float.

explosion.en: The blast rolled me over onto my back.

projectile.zh: 箭擦过壳面,留下一道白痕。
projectile.en: The arrow grazed my shell and left a white line.

magic.zh: 咒文绕过壳,直接咬住我。
magic.en: The spell slipped past my shell and bit me.

starvation.zh: 没有花蜜,我的腿开始发软。
starvation.en: No nectar, and my legs begin to soften.

lightning.en: Lightning runs my shell down to my feet.

void.en: The ground is gone, and even the wind.

walk.zh: 我不走,我只是漂过去。
walk.en: I do not walk. I simply drift past.

walk.zh: 海流推我,我顺着它。
walk.en: The current pushes and I follow it.

walk.zh: 触须摆一下,我就前进了。
walk.en: One sway of my tendril carries me forward.

walk.zh: 暖水在前面,我朝那边去。
walk.en: Warm water lies ahead, so I head there.

walk.zh: 我贴着水面滑,不起波纹。
walk.en: I skim the surface without raising a ripple.

walk.zh: 漂得慢,可我从不迷路。
walk.en: I drift slowly, yet I am never lost.

walk.zh: 这片海的味道,我认得。
walk.en: I know the taste of this sea.

walk.zh: 我绕开礁石,轻轻一转。
walk.en: I turn gently around the reef.

walk.zh: 水里更省力,我就下来了。
walk.en: Water is easier, so I came down into it.

walk.zh: 我飘过的地方,水面会亮。
walk.en: The water brightens where I pass.

walk.zh: 不管漂多远,我知道回去的路。
walk.en: However far I drift, I know the way back.

walk.zh: 浪推我一下,我笑了一下。
walk.en: A wave nudges me and I smile.

idle.en: I rest on the surface and soak up the sun.

idle.zh: 气泡从下面冒上来,很暖。
idle.en: Bubbles rise from below. They are warm.

idle.zh: 我把头埋进水里听声音。
idle.en: I dip my head under to listen.
The water is just right. I need not move.

idle.zh: 头顶的珠子慢慢转着光。
idle.en: The gem on my head turns its light slowly.
I wait for the tide to change direction.
There is a boat far off. I keep away.

idle.zh: 触须随水摆,像在打拍子。
idle.en: My tendril sways like it is keeping time.

idle.zh: 这片海我记得,出生也在这。
idle.en: I remember this sea. I was born here.

idle.zh: 我闭眼一会儿,水托着我。
idle.en: I close my eyes a while; the water holds me.
When it is quiet, the sea speaks.
I count the waves. One, two, three.

idle.zh: 身上的水珠一颗都没干。
idle.en: Not one droplet on me has dried.

idle.zh: 我在这里,哪儿也不急着去。
idle.en: I am here, in no hurry to go anywhere.

look_player.zh: 你在岸上站了很久。
look_player.en: You have stood on the shore a long while.

look_player.zh: 你的靴子湿了,是等我吗。
look_player.en: Your boots are wet. Were you waiting for me?

look_player.zh: 我抬头看你,水里更自在。
look_player.en: I look up at you; I am freer in water.

look_player.zh: 你的手上有盐的味道。
look_player.en: There is salt on your hands.

look_player.zh: 你蹲下来了,我就不那么怕。
look_player.en: You crouch down, so I am less afraid.

look_player.zh: 我游近一点,只一点点。
look_player.en: I swim a little closer. Only a little.

look_player.zh: 你的影子落在水上,我躲开。
look_player.en: Your shadow falls on the water and I slip aside.

look_player.zh: 你在数我的触须吗。
look_player.en: Are you counting my tendrils?

look_player.zh: 我从你眼睛里看到海。
look_player.en: I see the sea in your eyes.

look_player.zh: 你笑得像退潮后的沙滩。
look_player.en: You smile like a beach after the tide leaves.

look_player.zh: 别伸手太快,水会晃。
look_player.en: Do not reach so fast; the water will shake.

look_player.zh: 我绕着你转半圈,再回来。
look_player.en: I circle half around you and come back.

look_player.zh: 你说话时,水面跟着颤。
look_player.en: When you speak, the water trembles.

look_player.zh: 我愿意再看你一会儿。
look_player.en: I am willing to watch you a while longer.

tempted.en: Is that seaweed? Give me a piece.

tempted.zh: 你手里的东西在水里会沉。
tempted.en: What you hold would sink in water.

tempted.zh: 我闻到咸味,是给我的吗。
tempted.en: I taste salt. Is it for me?

tempted.zh: 亮亮的贝壳,比食物好看。
tempted.en: That bright shell is prettier than food.
I have come closer, but I have not agreed.

tempted.zh: 你把它放在水面,我就来。
tempted.en: Set it on the surface and I will come.
Do not squeeze it. It will break.

tempted.zh: 我探头嗅了嗅,又缩回去。
tempted.en: I poke my head out, sniff, and draw back.
I have eaten this before. It is passable.
One bite only. I still have to go home.

collide.zh: 你撞过来,水花溅了一身。
collide.en: You bumped me and water splashed everywhere.

collide.zh: 这一推,我在水里绕了一圈。
collide.en: That shove spun me a full turn in the water.
Bumping in water does not hurt, only startles.
You stepped into the shallows and hit me.
I float up and give you the path.
The wave delivered me to your feet.
Do not feel your way with your feet. I can see.
That one left me a little dizzy.
I back off a few paces and rise again.
The surface is churned. I must wait for it to calm.

mate.zh: 我这类很少遇见同伴。
mate.en: My kind seldom meet one another.

mate.zh: 海流把两个漂到一起,很难得。
mate.en: The current brings two together. That is rare.

mate.zh: 我不叫,只用触须碰一碰。
mate.en: I do not call. I touch with a tendril.

mate.zh: 我们绕着圈,顺着同一个流。
mate.en: We circle, riding the same current.

mate.zh: 出生地的水,会记住这件事。
mate.en: The water of my birthplace will remember this.

mate.zh: 慢一点,别把水搅浑。
mate.en: Slow down. Do not cloud the water.

mate.zh: 我头顶的光变柔和了。
mate.en: The light on my head has gone soft.

mate.zh: 这不算热闹,但很安稳。
mate.en: It is not lively, but it is calm.

mate.zh: 我们把这段海流走完。
mate.en: Let us finish this stretch of current together.

mate.zh: 之后,各自漂回出生的地方。
mate.en: Afterward, each drifts back to where it was born.

pickup.en: I gather the shell between my tendrils.

pickup.zh: 太沉的东西,水会替我拿。
pickup.en: The water carries what is too heavy for me.
I lift a small stone to look at it.
This spiral shell would sit well on my head.
It slipped. I will scoop it up again.
I roll up the seaweed and carry it off.

pickup.zh: 手里拿不下,就含在嘴里。
pickup.en: My hands are full, so I hold it in my mouth.

pickup.zh: 带上这个,回去有东西看。
pickup.en: I will take this home to look at.
Things in water sit steady in my grip.
When I let go, I let it sink slowly.

target_acquire.zh: 水里有东西在动,我停下。
target_acquire.en: Something moves in the water. I stop.
I dive first and look before deciding.
It is bigger than me. I will not hurry.

target_acquire.zh: 水流会告诉我它往哪去。
target_acquire.en: The current will tell me where it goes.

target_acquire.zh: 我把身体沉下去,藏住光。
target_acquire.en: I sink and hide my light.
At this distance I can still turn away.
I have its shape memorized.
I pick it because it is alone.
Things in the sea are done slowly.

target_acquire.zh: 我贴着海底靠近,不带声音。
target_acquire.en: I close in along the seabed, silent.

targeting.en: I follow the ripples, not the shadow.

targeting.zh: 它每动一次,我就近一点。
targeting.en: Every time it moves, I get closer.
Its bubbles give away its place.

targeting.zh: 我绕着它,不让它看见背。
targeting.en: I circle it and never show my back.

targeting.zh: 耐心,海教会我的第一件事。
targeting.en: Patience: the sea taught me that first.
It is panicking. The water is churning.
One more breath, until it turns.
I have its breathing rhythm.
No shouting. In water it is useless.
Close now. Close enough to touch a fin.

melee_attack.en: I push out a sheet of water. It is light.
I struck, and recoiled too.
I am not good at hitting, but I can block.
The splash blinds it. That is enough.

melee_attack.zh: 我用头一顶,再用触须缠。
melee_attack.en: I butt with my head, then wrap a tendril.

melee_attack.zh: 这一下,我用了全身的力。
melee_attack.en: That one used all the strength I have.
Do not push me. I do not want to hurt.
I borrow the current to shove it back.
The blow is done and I am a little winded.

melee_attack.zh: 水里打架,总是两败俱伤。
melee_attack.en: Fights in water leave both sides worse.

spawn.en: I roll up out of the warm current.

spawn.zh: 这片海的水温,刚好合我。
spawn.en: The temperature of this sea suits me.

spawn.zh: 我又回到出生的这片水。
spawn.en: I am back in the water where I was born.

spawn.zh: 水面很亮,我眨了几下眼。
spawn.en: The surface is bright. I blink a few times.
The tide carried me to the shore.

spawn.zh: 我先试了试水流的方向。
spawn.en: First I tested which way the current ran.
This small body fits me just right.

spawn.zh: 远处有礁,我记得那块石头。
spawn.en: There is a reef out there. I know that rock.
I surface and take a breath first.
Wherever I come from, I always return.

spawn.zh: 水里没有路,可我不迷路。
spawn.en: Water has no roads, yet I am not lost.
The warm current moves. I follow it.

generic.en: The splash clears and I back away twice.
It does not hurt. It only startled me.
My body rocked from the blow.

generic.zh: 我沉下去一点,又浮上来。
generic.en: I sink a little, then rise again.
You struck my tendril.
Blows in water sound muffled.
I curl up and guard my head.
I need a moment after that.
I have not decided to hit back.
It hurts, but not badly.

fire.zh: 火在水面上烧,我怕这个。
fire.en: Fire burns on the surface. I fear that.

fall.zh: 我从水面被抛起,重重落下。
fall.en: I was flung up and came down hard.

drown.zh: 我本就在水里,可也会憋闷。
drown.en: I live in water, yet I can still smother.

explosion.zh: 炸开的水把我推得很远。
explosion.en: The blast sent me far through the water.

projectile.zh: 箭穿过水面,擦过我的身侧。
projectile.en: The arrow cut the water past my flank.

magic.zh: 那道光钻进水里,找到了我。
magic.en: The light entered the water and found me.

starvation.zh: 饿久了,头顶的光也淡了。
starvation.en: Hungry too long, my head-light dims.

lightning.zh: 电顺着水面爬过来,麻得刺骨。
lightning.en: Lightning crawled over the water, stinging.

void.zh: 水没了,我连漂都做不到。
void.en: The water is gone. I cannot even drift.

walk.zh: 小短腿跑起来,停不住。
walk.en: My short legs get going and cannot stop.

walk.zh: 我踩过落叶,咔嚓一声。
walk.en: I step on a leaf. It crunches.

walk.zh: 尾巴一摆,我就拐了弯。
walk.en: One flick of my tail and I turn.

walk.zh: 我走两步,蹦一下。
walk.en: I take two steps, then hop.

walk.zh: 草比我高,我踮着脚走。
walk.en: The grass is taller than me. I walk on tiptoe.

walk.zh: 地面有点麻,是我的脚。
walk.en: The ground tingles. That is my feet.

walk.zh: 我跑得太快,撞了树根。
walk.en: I ran too fast and hit a root.

walk.zh: 一边走,一边回头看。
walk.en: I walk while looking back over my shoulder.

walk.zh: 小小的步子,频率很高。
walk.en: Small steps, very fast.

walk.zh: 我踩着影子走,像在追它。
walk.en: I walk on my shadow as if chasing it.

walk.zh: 脚底一滑,我赶紧停住。
walk.en: My feet slip and I stop myself quickly.

walk.zh: 我不走直线,直线太无聊。
walk.en: I do not walk straight. Straight is boring.

idle.en: I sit down and scratch my ear.
My cheek itches. That is the electricity.
I stare at an anthill.
My tail goes up, then down.

idle.zh: 我打了个小呵欠,冒了火星。
idle.en: I yawn and a spark pops out.
My ears swivel. I hear the wind.
I curl myself into a ball.

idle.zh: 刚才那下电,把我自己麻了。
idle.en: That last spark numbed me.
I count my toes. Four of them.
The sun warms my back.

idle.zh: 我抖了抖毛,掉了两粒尘。
idle.en: I shake my fur and two specks fall.
A bug flew past. I missed it.
I hop once, for no reason.
Stay still a while and the charge settles.

look_player.zh: 你蹲下来了,好高的人。
look_player.en: You crouched down. You were so tall.

look_player.zh: 我歪头,你为什么不说话。
look_player.en: I tilt my head. Why are you quiet?

look_player.zh: 你的手好大,像一块石头。
look_player.en: Your hand is huge, like a stone.

look_player.zh: 我先闻闻你的鞋尖。
look_player.en: First I sniff the tip of your boot.

look_player.zh: 你身上有股火的味道。
look_player.en: You smell faintly of fire.

look_player.zh: 我退一步,又前进一步。
look_player.en: I step back, then step forward again.

look_player.zh: 你眼睛里有我,小小的。
look_player.en: I am in your eyes, very small.

look_player.zh: 我不怕你,只是有点紧张。
look_player.en: I am not afraid of you. Only nervous.

look_player.zh: 你笑的时候,我不那么抖了。
look_player.en: When you smile, I stop trembling so much.

look_player.zh: 我的耳朵朝你转过去了。
look_player.en: My ears have turned toward you.

look_player.zh: 你手里那样东西正晃我的眼。
look_player.en: Whatever you hold is dazzling my eyes.

look_player.zh: 我抬头看你,脖子有点酸。
look_player.en: I look up at you and my neck aches.

look_player.zh: 你会不会也想摸我的头。
look_player.en: Do you want to pat my head too?

look_player.zh: 我眨眨眼,把电收起来了。
look_player.en: I blink and put my spark away.

tempted.en: That berry is red.

tempted.zh: 我闻到甜味,耳朵先动了。
tempted.en: I smell sweetness. My ears react first.

tempted.zh: 你放在地上,我自己过去。
tempted.en: Put it on the ground and I will come.
I reach for it. Almost there.
Do not wave it. My eyes cannot follow.
Before eating, I touch it once.
One bite and the sourness makes me shiver.

tempted.zh: 我抱着果子,转身背对你。
tempted.en: I hug the berry and turn my back to you.
My cheek charge feels fuller now.
Is there more? I will not refuse.

collide.en: Eek, I rolled a full circle.

collide.zh: 我太小了,你根本没看见我。
collide.en: I am so small you did not see me.
I bounced once and sat down.
That bump threw sparks.
I get up and check my tail first.
Your foot is like a wall.
I shocked myself too.
Do not step. I am by your feet.
I shake my head to throw off the dizziness.
Next time I will squeak before I move.

mate.zh: 我的电还小,先不急。
mate.en: My spark is still small. No rush.

mate.zh: 我用尾巴碰碰对方的尾巴。
mate.en: I touch my tail to the other's tail.

mate.zh: 太亮了,我会害羞。
mate.en: It is too bright. I get shy.

mate.zh: 两颗电气囊靠近,会噼啪响。
mate.en: Two cheek sacs close together crackle.

mate.zh: 我先绕一圈,看看它。
mate.en: I circle once to look at it.

mate.zh: 我们蹭蹭脸颊,算是说好了。
mate.en: We rub cheeks. That counts as agreed.

mate.zh: 别看我,我会紧张。
mate.en: Do not watch. I get nervous.

mate.zh: 电要收住,不然会麻到它。
mate.en: I must hold my charge or it will sting.

mate.zh: 这片草够软,可以待着。
mate.en: This grass is soft enough to stay in.

mate.zh: 我的耳朵贴下去了,是答应。
mate.en: My ears are flat. That is a yes.

pickup.zh: 这么小一颗,我也拿得动。
pickup.en: It is small. I can carry it.
I lift it and nearly get flattened.
I carry it in both front paws.
I dropped it. I pick it up and go on.

pickup.zh: 这个放嘴里,那个抱怀里。
pickup.en: This one in my mouth, that one in my arms.
Too heavy. I drag, then rest.
I pile my things at the base of a tree.

pickup.zh: 亮的东西,我喜欢藏起来。
pickup.en: I like hiding bright things.
It will not stay, so I curl my tail around it.
Carry it home. Do not drop it on the way.

target_acquire.en: Something moved over there. Something small.
I prick my ears and listen first.
If it is not food, I will not chase.
It is bigger. I hide behind the grass.
The charge is building in my cheeks.
I lower my body and stiffen my tail.
First I squeak at it, to test.
It does not react, so neither do I.
At this distance I can still run.
I have its smell now.

targeting.en: I follow it, not daring to get close.
When it looks back, I play dumb.
My feet are light. The grass stays quiet.

targeting.zh: 再靠近,我的电就漏出来了。
targeting.en: Closer and my charge will leak out.
It turns. I turn.
I count its steps. Three more.

targeting.zh: 心跳好快,耳朵都听见了。
targeting.en: My heart is racing. My ears hear it.
I wait for it to lower its head to drink.

targeting.zh: 这条路线我熟,可以绕过去。
targeting.en: I know this route. I can go around.
Almost. Right behind that clump of grass.

melee_attack.en: I charge in and let out a shock.
It is a small move, but it stings.
I got shocked by my own attack.
I headbutt, then retreat fast.
A flash of light, only for an instant.
I bite its tail and hold on.
One hit and I am out of breath.
Stay back. My cheeks are crackling.
I put everything into that one.
Afterward my legs feel weak.

spawn.en: I squeeze out from between the grass blades.
This place is huge, and I am so small.
I am only level five and barely fight.
The soil under my feet is cool.
First I shake the grass bits off my fur.
The sunlight is too bright. I squint.
A new place, with new smells too.

spawn.zh: 我的脸颊已经在充电了。
spawn.en: My cheeks are already charging.
There is a sound. I hide first.
Grass this tall is perfect to hide me.

spawn.zh: 出生就是这样,突然出现。
spawn.en: Being born is like this: suddenly here.
I take my first step carefully.

generic.en: Ow, that one really tingled.
The hit rolled me over.
I am small, so it hurts at once.

generic.zh: 我背上的毛一根根支起来。
generic.en: The fur along my back stands up one by one.
After that, I want to hide.
My ears are flat against my head.

generic.zh: 电漏出来了,我自己也麻。
generic.en: My charge leaked and numbed me.
I back up behind the tree root.
My tail is wrapped in front of me.
It hurts, but I will not cry.

fire.zh: 火一靠近,我的毛就焦了。
fire.en: The fire came close and singed my fur.

fall.en: I fell and rolled several times.

drown.zh: 水太深,我扑腾着够不到底。
drown.en: Too deep. I paddle and cannot reach the bottom.

explosion.en: The boom threw me through the air.

projectile.en: The arrow stuck in the dirt beside me.

magic.en: That light left my whole body numb.

starvation.en: Too hungry to charge my cheeks.

lightning.zh: 天上的电比我的强太多了。
lightning.en: The lightning above is far stronger than mine.

void.zh: 下面什么都没有,我不敢看。
void.en: There is nothing below. I dare not look.

walk.zh: 我落地走几步,翅膀收着。
walk.en: I land and take a few steps, wings folded.

walk.zh: 爪子抓着草根,稳稳的。
walk.en: My talons grip the grass roots, steady.

walk.zh: 我走得像在巡视这片草地。
walk.en: I walk as if inspecting this grassland.

walk.zh: 翅膀碰了一下草尖。
walk.en: My wing brushes a grass tip.

walk.zh: 大步跨过小沟,不带停。
walk.en: I stride over the ditch without pausing.

walk.zh: 头冠的羽毛一颠一颠。
walk.en: My crest feathers bob with each step.

walk.zh: 我边走边看天上。
walk.en: I watch the sky while I walk.

walk.zh: 这段路我飞过一百次。
walk.en: I have flown this stretch a hundred times.

walk.zh: 落地时扬起一点尘土。
walk.en: My landing kicks up a little dust.

walk.zh: 风向变了,我换了条路。
walk.en: The wind shifted, so I changed route.

walk.zh: 走着走着,我有点想飞。
walk.en: A few steps in, I want to fly again.

walk.zh: 草地是我的地界,我慢慢走。
walk.en: This grassland is mine. I walk it slowly.

idle.en: I stand and let the wind run through my feathers.
I preen the feathers on my chest.

idle.zh: 头冠被风吹歪了,我理正。
idle.en: The wind bent my crest. I set it right.
I stare at the treetops far away.
One wingbeat tests the wind.

idle.zh: 我听见田里有东西在跑。
idle.en: I hear something running in the field.
The sun has warmed my back.
I do not call. Calling scares off prey.
I scrape my talons twice on the ground.
I know the air currents here best.
I look up. The clouds are heading east.
Rest long enough and my wings itch.

idle.zh: 我把一只翅膀伸展到极限。
idle.en: I stretch one wing to its full span.
The grassland is quiet, save the grass.

look_player.zh: 你站在下风口,我闻到了。
look_player.en: You stand downwind. I smelled you.

look_player.zh: 我抬高头,从上往下看你。
look_player.en: I raise my head and look down at you.

look_player.zh: 你手里没有弓,很好。
look_player.en: You hold no bow. Good.

look_player.zh: 我侧头,一只眼看你就够。
look_player.en: I turn my head. One eye is enough.

look_player.zh: 你的帽子会被风刮走的。
look_player.en: The wind will take that hat of yours.

look_player.zh: 你退后了,算你识相。
look_player.en: You stepped back. Wise of you.

look_player.zh: 我翅膀半张,是提醒。
look_player.en: My wings are half open. That is a warning.

look_player.zh: 你衣角沾着晒过的谷香。
look_player.en: Your hem carries the smell of sun-dried grain.

look_player.zh: 我在看你的手,不是你的脸。
look_player.en: I am watching your hands, not your face.

look_player.zh: 你敢直视我,胆子不小。
look_player.en: You meet my eye. That takes nerve.

look_player.zh: 风把我的头冠吹向你。
look_player.en: The wind blows my crest toward you.

look_player.zh: 你不跑,我就不追。
look_player.en: If you do not run, I will not chase.

look_player.zh: 我眨了一下眼,慢慢的那种。
look_player.en: I blink once, slowly.

look_player.zh: 这片草地容得下你,暂时。
look_player.en: This grassland has room for you. For now.

tempted.zh: 谷粒洒在地上,我看见了。
tempted.en: Grain scattered on the ground. I see it.

tempted.zh: 我不吃地上的碎屑,除非新鲜。
tempted.en: I do not eat scraps unless they are fresh.
You scattered it too far for me to reach.

tempted.zh: 翅膀一收,我落下来看看。
tempted.en: I fold my wings and drop down to look.
That is not even a mouthful.

tempted.zh: 我先绕着走一圈,再决定。
tempted.en: I circle it once before deciding.
Something moved. I am done with this food.
Step away and I will lower my head.
It is plain, but I am hungry.
I eat and leave. I owe you nothing.

collide.zh: 你撞在我翅膀上,像撞墙。
collide.en: You hit my wing like hitting a wall.
I step back half a pace, feathers ruffled.

collide.zh: 风一鼓,我差点把你掀倒。
collide.en: One gust and I nearly knocked you down.

collide.zh: 看路,我落地是有重量的。
collide.en: Watch where you walk. I land with weight.
That bump will leave your shoulder sore.
I spread my wings to steady myself.
You stepped on my tail feathers.
I dislike being bumped from the side.

collide.zh: 脚下这一小片草被压折了。
collide.en: A small patch of grass is bent under our feet.
Go around me next time. It saves trouble.

mate.zh: 我在天上画圈,它就懂了。
mate.en: I circle in the sky and it understands.

mate.zh: 翅膀拍得慢一些,是邀请。
mate.en: Slower wingbeats are an invitation.

mate.zh: 两只一起飞,气流才顺。
mate.en: Two flying together find the air smoother.

mate.zh: 我用叫声划出这片天空。
mate.en: I mark this sky with my call.

mate.zh: 它落在我的树枝上,算答应了。
mate.en: It landed on my branch. That is a yes.

mate.zh: 头冠要立得直,才显得精神。
mate.en: The crest must stand straight to look worthy.

mate.zh: 我们并排飞,谁也不抢前。
mate.en: We fly side by side, neither pulling ahead.

mate.zh: 巢要搭在高处,风大也不怕。
mate.en: The nest goes high, where wind does not matter.

mate.zh: 吵起来的时候,我就先飞开。
mate.en: When we argue, I fly off first.

mate.zh: 草原上空的航线,我们共用。
mate.en: We share the flight paths above the grassland.

pickup.en: I take it up in my talons.
Too heavy. I drag it a couple of steps.

pickup.zh: 飞起来拿,比在地上省力。
pickup.en: Lifting it in flight is easier than on the ground.
This would line a nest nicely.
I carry it in my beak, keeping my feathers clean.

pickup.zh: 掉了一次,我俯冲捡回来。
pickup.en: I dropped it once and dove to retrieve it.
The branch is too long. I snap it in two.
I take only what I can use.
Grip secure. Taking off.
I set it by the nest and look for more.

target_acquire.en: Something runs below. Something small.
From up here it has nowhere to hide.
One circle first, to measure the distance.
The wind is with me and against it.

target_acquire.zh: 影子先落下去,它才知道。
target_acquire.en: My shadow lands first. Then it knows.
That one is too thin to be worth a dive.

target_acquire.zh: 我收翅,把自己变成一块石头。
target_acquire.en: I fold my wings and become a stone.
Target chosen. No changing.
It looks up. Too late.
On the grassland, the fast one wins.

targeting.en: I move with its shadow.

targeting.zh: 它往草丛钻,我看得见草动。
targeting.en: It dives into grass. I see the grass move.
My altitude drops. Perfect.
I hold. Rushing would spook it.
It paused. Right there.
I bank and use the wind to drop.
It is running now. Better still.

targeting.zh: 地面越来越近,我数三下。
targeting.en: The ground nears. I count three.

targeting.zh: 羽毛贴着身体,减少响声。
targeting.en: Feathers tight to my body, to cut noise.

targeting.zh: 一瞬就够了,不需要第二次。
targeting.en: One instant is enough. No second chance.

melee_attack.en: One wingbeat and the grass lies flat.
The talons arrive first, the body after.
I come down out of the sky.
This gust could snap a large tree.
I grab and pull upward.
I use talons, not my beak. More accurate.
Miss and I pull up at once.
My wing sweeps past and it loses footing.
The wind here answers to me.
Done, and not one feather out of place.

spawn.zh: 我从云底穿下来,落在地上。
spawn.en: I drop through the cloud base and land.
Good visibility on this grassland.

spawn.zh: 三四十级的力气,刚好用得上。
spawn.en: Strength of level forty is just right here.
Wings still open, I listen to the wind first.
The grass is tall and the insects plentiful.

spawn.zh: 我落在最高的那棵树上。
spawn.en: I land in the tallest tree.

spawn.zh: 这里的气流不熟,先试一圈。
spawn.en: I do not know these currents. One test circle.
Crest up. Time to patrol.
The ground is far below.
One long call, and the border is drawn.
The wind here is harder than elsewhere.

spawn.zh: 落地的尘土散开,我到了。
spawn.en: The dust of my landing clears. I have arrived.

generic.en: A few feathers flew. No matter.
That blow pushed me back half a step.
My wing dipped. I righted it quickly.

generic.zh: 疼,但还没到落地的时候。
generic.en: It hurts, but not enough to ground me.
I was struck out of the air.
There is a tear in my wing.
Two wingbeats and I can still fly.
You hit an old wound.
I crouch, ready to rise again.

generic.zh: 这点伤,换不来我的退让。
generic.en: This wound will not buy my retreat.

fire.zh: 火燎到翼尖,飞起来会歪。
fire.en: Fire singed my wingtip; flight will be uneven.

fall.zh: 我从高空坠下,砸出一个坑。
fall.en: I fell from high up and left a crater.

drown.zh: 羽毛进了水,沉得像石头。

explosion.en: The blast wave flipped me over.

projectile.zh: 箭穿进翅膀,我飞不快了。
projectile.en: An arrow through my wing slows me.

magic.zh: 那道光锁住我,翅膀发沉。
magic.en: That light binds me and my wings grow heavy.

starvation.en: Hungry too long, two circles wind me.

lightning.zh: 雷打在我身上,羽毛全竖起来。
lightning.en: Lightning struck me and every feather stood up.

void.zh: 下面没有地,我不敢收翅。
void.en: No ground below. I dare not fold my wings.
